```{ojs}
S0 = FileAttachment("../data/states.csv").csv({typed: true})
IDX = FileAttachment("../data/inst_index.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
S = S0.map(d => ({...d, dpk: d.pk_2024 - d.pk_2012, dpkw: d.pkw_2024 - d.pkw_2012, ddual: d.dual_2023 - d.dual_2013}))
CLL = ({all: "All surviving institutions", pub4: "Public 4-year", pub2: "Public 2-year (community colleges)", priv4: "Private nonprofit 4-year"})
SM = [
  {k: "pct_2012_2024", l: "Fall FTE students, % change FY2012–24", f: d => s0(d) + "%", div: true},
  {k: "dpk", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, change FY2012–24 (typical institution)", f: s0, div: true},
  {k: "dpkw", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, change FY2012–24 (all staff ÷ all students)", f: s0, div: true},
  {k: "pk_2024", l: "Staff per 1,000 students, FY2024 (typical institution)", f: f0},
  {k: "dual_2023", l: "Dual-enrollment intensity, fall 2023 (per 100 residents aged 15–17)", f: f1, statewide: true},
  {k: "ddual", l: "Change in dual-enrollment intensity, fall 2013–23", f: s1, statewide: true}]
SMB = new Map(SM.map(m => [m.k, m]))
```

```{ojs}
{
  const a = S.filter(d => d.cl === "pub2" && isFinite(d.pct_2012_2024));
  const fell = a.filter(d => d.pct_2012_2024 < 0).length;
  const rose = a.filter(d => d.dpk > 0).length;
  return md`<div class="cs-lead">Community-college enrollment fell from FY2012 to FY2024 in <b>${fell} of ${a.length}</b> states with surviving community colleges, and community-college staff per 1,000 students rose in <b>${rose}</b> of them. Pick a measure and a type of institution for the map; click a state for its detail.</div>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-links}
Read more: [white paper §5](../paper/index.qmd#sec-5) (the denominator) and [§6](../paper/index.qmd#sec-6) (population shocks). Substack post: Post 2 (link on publication).
:::

```{ojs}
viewof sm = Inputs.select(SM.map(m => m.k), {format: k => SMB.get(k).l, value: param("map", "pct_2012_2024"), label: "Map measure"})
viewof cl = Inputs.radio(new Map(Object.entries(CLL).map(([k, v]) => [v, k])), {value: param("cl", "pub2"), label: "Institutions", disabled: false})
viewof st = Inputs.select(STLIST, {format: s => STNAME[s], value: param("st", "IN"), label: "State"})
viewof mode = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Map", "map"], ["Table", "table"]]), {value: param("view", "map"), label: "View"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("map", sm === "pct_2012_2024" ? null : sm); setParam("cl", cl === "pub2" ? null : cl); setParam("st", st); setParam("view", mode === "map" ? null : mode);
  const m = SMB.get(sm);
  const rows = S.filter(d => d.cl === (m.statewide ? "all" : cl));
  if (mode === "table") {
    return Inputs.table(rows.map(d => ({...d, name: STNAME[d.st]})), {columns: ["name", "n", "fte_2012", "fte_2024", "pct_2012_2024", "pk_2012", "pk_2024", "pkw_2012", "pkw_2024", "dual_2013", "dual_2023"],
      header: {name: "State", n: "Institutions", fte_2012: "FTE FY2012", fte_2024: "FTE FY2024", pct_2012_2024: "% change", pk_2012: "Staff/1,000 FY2012", pk_2024: "FY2024", pkw_2012: "Weighted FY2012", pkw_2024: "Weighted FY2024", dual_2013: "Dual 2013", dual_2023: "Dual 2023"},
      format: {fte_2012: f0, fte_2024: f0, pct_2012_2024: s1, pk_2012: f0, pk_2024: f0, pkw_2012: f0, pkw_2024: f0, dual_2013: f1, dual_2023: f1}, sort: sm in rows[0] ? sm : "pct_2012_2024", rows: 20});
  }
  const data = rows.map(d => ({st: d.st, v: d[sm]}));
  const vals = data.map(d => d.v).filter(isFinite);
  const a = d3.max(vals, Math.abs);
  const cs = m.div ? {type: "diverging", domain: [-a, a], scheme: "rdbu", pivot: 0, reverse: sm !== "pct_2012_2024"} : {type: "linear", domain: d3.extent(vals), scheme: "blues"};
  const sc = Plot.scale({color: cs});
  return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start">
    ${tileMap(data, {color: v => sc.apply(v), fmt: m.f, selected: st, onPick: s => setView(viewof st, s), w: Math.min(width, 700)})}
    <div style="max-width:300px">${Plot.legend({color: cs, label: m.l, width: Math.min(280, width - 20)})}
    <p class="cs-note">${m.statewide ? "Dual-enrollment intensity is statewide (public under-18 undergraduates per 100 residents aged 15–17), so the institution type does not apply." : `${CLL[cl]}. Grey: no surviving institution of this type.`} Click a state for its detail below.</p></div></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const R = S.filter(d => d.st === st);
  const g = k => R.find(d => d.cl === k) ?? {};
  const a = g("all");
  return md`## ${STNAME[st]}
<div class="cs-kpis">
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${s0(a.pct_2012_2024)}%</div><div class="l">fall FTE students FY2012→24, all ${a.n ?? 0} surviving institutions (${f0(a.fte_2012)} → ${f0(a.fte_2024)})</div></div>
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${f0(a.pk_2012)} → ${f0(a.pk_2024)}</div><div class="l">staff per 1,000 students, typical institution, FY2012 → FY2024</div></div>
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${f1(a.dual_2013)} → ${f1(a.dual_2023)}</div><div class="l">dual-enrollment intensity per 100 residents aged 15–17, fall 2013 → 2023 (national 6.1 → 12.4)</div></div>
</div>`;
}
```

<div class="cs-two">

```{ojs}
{
  const R = S.filter(d => d.st === st && d.cl !== "all");
  const pts = R.flatMap(d => [1990, 2000, 2012, 2024].map(y => ({cl: CLL[d.cl], fy: y, v: d[`fte_${y}`], n: d.n})));
  const C = {"Public 4-year": "#2a78d6", "Public 2-year (community colleges)": "#eda100", "Private nonprofit 4-year": "#008300"};
  return Plot.plot({
    width: half(width), height: 300, marginLeft: 60, title: "Fall FTE students, surviving institutions",
    x: {...yearAxis, ticks: [1990, 2000, 2012, 2024]}, y: {grid: true, label: null},
    color: {domain: Object.keys(C), range: Object.values(C), legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "fy", y: "v", stroke: "cl", strokeWidth: 2, marker: "dot"}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => `${d.cl}, FY${d.fy}: ${f0(d.v)} FTE (${d.n} institutions)`}))]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const R = S.filter(d => d.st === st && d.cl !== "all");
  return html`<h4 style="font-size:1rem;margin:.3rem 0 .5rem">By type of institution</h4><div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>n</th><th>FTE FY2012–24</th><th>Staff per 1,000 FY2012</th><th>FY2024</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${R.map(d => html`<tr><td>${CLL[d.cl]}</td><td>${d.n}</td><td>${s0(d.pct_2012_2024)}%</td><td>${f0(d.pk_2012)}</td><td>${f0(d.pk_2024)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table></div>
    <p class="cs-note">Small groups (a few institutions) move a lot from one college's change. Staff per 1,000: mean of institution ratios.</p>`;
}
```

</div>

```{ojs}
{
  const L = IDX.filter(d => d.st === st && d.s24 === 1).sort((a, b) => (b.fte24 ?? 0) - (a.fte24 ?? 0));
  return html`<details><summary>Surviving institutions in ${STNAME[st]} (${L.length}); open one in the institution explorer</summary>
  <div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Institution</th><th>Sector</th><th>FTE FY2024</th><th>FTE FY13→24</th><th>Staff per student FY13→24</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${L.map(d => html`<tr><td><a href="../institution-explorer/index.html?id=${d.id}">${d.name}${d.campuses > 1 ? ` (+${d.campuses - 1} campuses)` : ""}</a></td><td>${SECL[d.sec]}</td><td>${f0(d.fte24)}</td><td>${s1(d.d_fte)}</td><td>${s1(d.d_ratio)}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table></div></details>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
**Data.** S24 surviving set (institutions with staff and fall FTE in FY1990, 2000, 2010, 2012 and every year FY2013–2025), grouped by the state of the main campus; Delta Cost-era systems that reported as one unit stay one unit, so a few states' public 4-year sector is a single system. Fall FTE = full-time plus one-third of part-time students. Staff per 1,000 = total headcount employees (IPEDS Human Resources, FY *t* = fall *t*−1) per 1,000 fall FTE students; total headcount is comparable across the 2012–13 HR redesign. Dual-enrollment intensity: IPEDS public undergraduates under 18 per 100 state residents aged 15–17 (Census/SEER). FY2024 IPEDS NCES provisional.
:::
